mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviewBoard(writer, email, subject, password, stars, content, upload1, upload2) VALUES (#{writer}, #{email}, #{subject}, #{password}, #{stars}, #{content}, #{upload1}, #{upload2})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM reviewBoard ORDER BY num DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE reviewBoard SET readcount = readcount + 1 WHERE num=#{num}
UPDATE reviewBoard SET subject=#{subject}, content=#{content} WHERE num=#{num} AND password=#{password}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM reviewBoard WHERE num=#{num} AND password=#{password}
